documents.title: Introduction: AI in Higher Education (CTL AI guidance hub; quotes the University Generative AI Policy)
documents.quality_note: Faculty guidance with three sample syllabus statements (permissive to prohibitive) and notes on AI detection and Dean's Discipline. It stands in for the official policy page, which could not be fetched.

notes: The official Provost Generative AI Policy (https://provost.columbia.edu/node/1973, also /content/generative-ai-policy) is INACCESSIBLE: Cloudflare challenge returns 'Just a moment...' (16 chars) to fetch_text.py, WebFetch gives 403, and the Wayback Machine has no copy. Search snippets show it says 'Absent a clear statement from a course instructor granting permission, the use of generative AI tools to complete an assignment or exam is prohibited', treated as unauthorized assistance or plagiarism. That is not verbatim fetched text and must not be coded from. It needs a manual save by the PI, or a browser route. GSAS AI guidance page (gsas.columbia.edu/ai-guidance-and-resources-gsas-students) was also blocked. Known URL (W4111 syllabus) is a course document, deferred. No Columbia Engineering or CS department AI policy found.
